chunks: And with this chain of narration, from Al-Husayn ibn Ali (peace be upon him), who said:
Indeed, the deeds of this nation are presented to Allah, the Exalted, every morning.
ai.seo_question: What happens to the deeds of the Muslim nation every morning according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, Imam al-Rida (a.s.) elucidates the concept of *ta'rid* (presentation), where the collective deeds of the Ummah are displayed before Allah daily, underscoring the immediacy of divine scrutiny. This aligns with the Shia scholarly understanding that while the final accounting occurs on Judgment Day, the daily presentation serves as a continuous spiritual check, encouraging believers to maintain *muraqabah* (God-consciousness) in their daily routines. It reinforces the idea that faith is not merely a static state but a dynamic practice requiring consistent alignment with divine will.
